programmes.title: Qāʿidah – Beginner
programmes.description: Perfect for absolute beginners. Learn the Arabic alphabet, proper pronunciation (makhārij), and basic reading skills. Build a solid foundation for Qurʾānic recitation.
programmes.longDescription: The Qāʿidah – Beginner programme is the first step in your Qurʾānic journey. Using the classical Qāʿidah method, students learn the Arabic alphabet, recognise letters in different positions, and master basic vowel marks (fatḥa, kasra, ḍamma) and their combinations. By the end, you will be able to read simple words and short phrases with correct pronunciation.
learningOutcomes: Recognise and pronounce all Arabic letters with correct makhārij
Read simple words and short sentences with proper vowel marks
Apply basic rules of sukūn, shaddah, and tanwīn
Build a strong foundation for Qāʿidah – Upper or direct Qurʾān reading

modules.title: The Arabic Alphabet
topics: Recognition of all 28 letters in isolated forms
Pronunciation from correct articulation points
Identifying letters in initial, medial, and final positions

modules.title: Short Vowels (Harakāt)
topics: Fatḥa ( َ ), Kasra ( ِ ), Ḍamma ( ُ ) – pronunciation and usage
Reading simple three-letter words
Combining consonants and vowels fluently

modules.title: Sukūn and Shaddah
topics: Understanding the absence of a vowel (sukūn)
Doubled consonants (shaddah) and their pronunciation
Reading words with sukūn and shaddah

modules.title: Basic Reading Practice
topics: Reading short phrases and sentences from the Qurʾān
Application of all rules learned
Introduction to simple tajwīd rules

programmes.prerequisites: No prior knowledge required. Open to all ages.
programmes.metaDescription: Learn the Arabic alphabet and basic reading skills with our beginner Qāʿidah programme. Build a solid foundation for Qurʾānic recitation.

programmes.title: Qāʿidah – Upper
programmes.description: Build on foundational skills to achieve fluency in reading. Master advanced rules of tajwīd and develop confidence in reading any part of the Qurʾān.
programmes.longDescription: The Qāʿidah – Upper programme is designed for students who have completed the beginner Qāʿidah or have basic reading skills. This course focuses on achieving fluency in reading the Qurʾān by mastering advanced tajwīd rules, proper rhythm, and stopping (waqf) techniques.
learningOutcomes: Read any part of the Qurʾān with fluency and proper tajwīd
Master advanced rules including idghām, iqlāb, and ikhfāʾ
Apply correct makhārij and ṣifāt in all letters
Understand and apply waqf (stopping) rules appropriately

modules.title: Advanced Tajwīd Rules
topics: Detailed study of idghām (merging) – types and applications
Iqlāb (conversion) and ikhfāʾ (hiding) rules
Rules of mīm sākinah and nūn sākinah/tanwīn

modules.title: Fluency and Rhythm
topics: Understanding and applying proper reading rhythm (tartīl)
Extended vowel lengths (madd) – natural and required
Connecting and stopping (waqf) – rules and etiquette

modules.title: Makhārij and Ṣifāt
topics: Deep dive into articulation points (makhārij)
Characteristics of letters (ṣifāt) – heavy, light, etc.
Correcting common pronunciation errors

modules.title: Selected Sūrah Reading
topics: Reading and reciting selected portions from Juz 29 and 30
Application of all tajwīd rules in context
Gradual increase in reading speed and accuracy

programmes.prerequisites: Completion of Qāʿidah – Beginner or equivalent knowledge.
programmes.metaDescription: Advance your Qurʾānic reading with our upper Qāʿidah programme. Master advanced tajwīd rules and fluency.

programmes.title: Qurʾān – Beginner
programmes.description: Move beyond reading to recitation with proper tajwīd. Begin memorisation of Juz ʿAmma (Juz 30) with understanding of basic meanings and Tafsīr.
programmes.longDescription: The Qurʾān – Beginner programme is designed for students who have completed the Qāʿidah – Upper or have equivalent reading fluency. This course shifts the focus from merely reading to reciting the Qurʾān with proper tajwīd, understanding of basic meanings, and beginning the blessed journey of memorisation.
learningOutcomes: Recite the Qurʾān with proper tajwīd and fluency
Memorise Juz ʿAmma (or a significant portion) with confidence
Understand the basic meanings and themes of short sūrahs
Build a strong foundation for advanced Qurʾānic studies

modules.title: Perfecting Tajwīd
topics: Comprehensive review and application of all tajwīd rules
Focus on makhārij and ṣifāt for fluent recitation
Rules of madd (extension) – types and lengths

modules.title: Juz ʿAmma – Recitation & Memorisation
topics: Systematic memorisation of short sūrahs (from An‑Nās to Ad‑Ḍuḥā)
Daily memorisation targets with review techniques
Individualised pacing based on student ability

modules.title: Basic Tafsīr & Vocabulary
topics: Word‑for‑word meaning of key verses in Juz ʿAmma
Understanding the context and themes of each sūrah
Introduction to Qurʾānic Arabic – common vocabulary

modules.title: Revision & Application
topics: Weekly revision of memorised portions
Practice reciting from the mushaf with proper tajwīd
Preparation for the Qurʾān – Upper programme

programmes.prerequisites: Completion of Qāʿidah – Upper or equivalent reading fluency.
programmes.metaDescription: Begin your Qurʾānic journey with recitation, tajwīd, and memorisation of Juz ʿAmma.

programmes.title: Qurʾān – Upper
programmes.description: For advanced students aiming for mastery. Deepen your recitation, memorisation, and understanding of the Qurʾān through detailed Tafsīr and linguistic analysis.
programmes.longDescription: The Qurʾān – Upper programme is the culmination of our Qurʾānic track, designed for students who have completed the Qurʾān – Beginner programme or have equivalent proficiency. This course focuses on achieving mastery in all aspects of Qurʾānic study: flawless recitation with advanced tajwīd, comprehensive memorisation, and deep understanding through Tafsīr and linguistic analysis.
learningOutcomes: Recite the entire Qurʾān with flawless tajwīd and mastery of qirāʾāt
Memorise the full Qurʾān (or a substantial portion) with confidence
Understand the Qurʾān through in-depth Tafsīr and thematic analysis
Analyse Qurʾānic Arabic grammatically and connect it to meaning

modules.title: Advanced Tajwīd & Qirāʾāt
topics: Complete mastery of all tajwīd rules with practical application
Study of the ten qirāʾāt (canonical recitations)
Advanced madd rules, waqf, and ibtidāʾ

modules.title: Ḥifẓ (Memorisation)
topics: Systematic memorisation of the entire Qurʾān (or customised portions)
Advanced memorisation techniques and revision strategies
Pathway to obtaining Ijāzah in ḥifẓ

modules.title: Tafsīr & Qurʾānic Sciences
topics: In-depth study of selected sūrahs and their Tafsīr
Thematic analysis of Qurʾānic concepts
Study of Asbāb al-Nuzūl (reasons for revelation)

modules.title: Iʿrāb & Linguistic Analysis
topics: Grammatical analysis (Iʿrāb) of selected verses
Understanding Arabic syntax and morphology in Qurʾānic context
Connecting linguistic structure to meaning

programmes.prerequisites: Completion of Qurʾān – Beginner or equivalent proficiency.
programmes.metaDescription: Master the Qurʾān with advanced recitation, complete tajwīd, in-depth Tafsīr, and full memorisation.
